doc.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Nicknames for people and more awards
summary: Heath talks about the unique names he gives people in his book and shows more awards.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yes, that was May 24th, 2002. I got it here, Benny Golson Master Award [from] Howard University. Here’s the Governor’s Award from real tacky, I mean Governor Pitaki.
(Laughs) You guys have names for everybody, too, don’t you?
It’s in my book; I got 200 in there. Unique names, I call em.
Gonzala Rubolcabra, he was my favorite.
Yeah, Blueberry Cobbler. I called him that, he didn’t mind. I saw him at the ASCAP ceremony. We got the Julliard was in 2002.
